about: Paul Merchants Ltd is a Chandigarh-operated financial-services group active since 1984. The parent is an RBI-authorised AD Category-II foreign-exchange and cross-border-payments intermediary offering travel and money-transfer services, while subsidiaries house lending, real estate and IT operations. Its shares are listed on BSE and permitted to trade on NSE under PML. [1] [2]
